question: Khelo India Winter Games 2023 was held at _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Winter Games 2023** was held in **Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
• This event is part of the **Khelo India initiative**, aimed at promoting sports at the grassroots level in India.
 
• The games included various winter sports such as **skiing, snowboarding, ice hockey, and more**.
 
• The event saw participation from numerous athletes across different states, showcasing their talents in winter sports.
 
• Jammu and Kashmir has been a popular destination for winter sports, making it an ideal location for these games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Khelo India program** was launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level.
 
• It aims to build a strong framework for all sports played in our country and establish India as a great sporting nation.
 
• The initiative also focuses on the development of sports infrastructure, talent identification, and long-term athlete development.
 
• In addition to winter games, **Khelo India** encompasses a variety of sports disciplines, including traditional and indigenous games.
 
• The program also provides financial assistance to talented athletes for their training and development.
